course_name_original: Inglés Aplicado a la Ingeniería Mecánica

learning_outcomes.text: Demonstrate the ability to analyze and synthesize.
Possess solid knowledge enabling oral and written communication in a foreign language, preferably English.
Possess knowledge of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT).
Information search and management skills.
Possess decision-making ability.
Develop critical reasoning.
Develop interpersonal skills.
Develop the ability to work in a team.
Ability to work in an international context.
Ability to work in an interdisciplinary team.
Knowledge of cultures and customs of other countries.
Knowledge of the English language to work in a technical environment in the field of mechanical engineering.
Sensitivity towards environmental issues.
Ability for a commitment to environmental quality.

Introduce the formal (lexical, grammatical, and discursive) features of technical English applied to the language of Mechanical Engineering, so that students are able to communicate independently in English in a scientific field.
Introduce vocabulary related to mechanical engineering.
Identify and know the most frequent suffixes to transform one class of words into others.
Introduce the basic rhetorical functions of scientific English.
Know the most frequent grammatical structures in technical English.
Develop English language communicative skills with special emphasis on written and oral language.
Develop technical text writing techniques.
Promote the acquisition of critical thinking and incorporate the principles and values of sustainable, inclusive, and egalitarian development, adapting learning outcomes to favor their integration.

teaching_methods: Classroom exposition of writing techniques, vocabulary, and specific expressions related to mechanical engineering.
Oral comprehension activities: presentations in English of material related to mechanical engineering.
Completion of reading, comprehension, and writing exercises.
Completion of tests using ICTs, to promote self-learning and self-assessment.
Completion of team works and their presentation in the classroom.
Informative summaries of technical texts from specialized magazines, engineering manuals, specialized websites, etc.
Completion of assignments, reports, memoirs, and evaluation tests

assessment_methods.method: Written and oral presentation of group works
Written test covering lexical, grammatical, vocabulary, written comprehension and expression, and oral comprehension
Technical vocabulary tests and activities carried out in and outside the classroom

assessment_rules: To pass the subject in the ordinary call, students must obtain at least 50% of the maximum grade in each assessment section. The grade obtained in the written and oral presentation of group works in the first call will be maintained for the second call, as this test is not recoverable. Students who have not passed by continuous assessment in the first call must take written and oral tests according to the approved academic calendar. For the second call, all tests from the first call will be evaluated, except for the oral presentation of the group work, whose grade will be the same as that obtained in the first call. Students with exceptional reasons preventing continuous assessment must apply in writing for 'exceptional assessment' within the first two weeks of the semester.
